t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Green orange yellow gnomes and exhaust until low numbers then try other

vb_textbox.text: Green, orange, yellow and blue will take you to one forest.The other colours to the other forest. One forest will yield more mushrooms than the other. Once you have exhausted one you can move to the other for higher yields (this should be when you are getting 1 or 2) If you are getting 1 or 2 and a 5 multiplier comes along I would go to the other forest, then back to the original one for single mushrooms until depleted. Make use of the 5x as thats most of the points.
